MT5._Provider_comment: v2: LiveBridge is the ONLY B-Book source. The MetaQuotes Manager API connector and its native DLLs were removed in Phase 2; setting Provider=Manager now throws at startup with a migration message rather than failing silently. Blank also selects LiveBridge. The feed is configured in the LiveBridge section below; the old Server/Login/Password/GroupMask keys are gone because the feed is keyed by URL + bearer key and never reads account_settings.

LiveBridge._comment: Only used when MT5:Provider = LiveBridge. The URL path names the source. ApiKey must come from the environment (LiveBridge__ApiKey), never from this file. StatePath empty = %LOCALAPPDATA%\CoverageManager\livebridge-state.json (the durable resume sequences). Times in ms.

Supabase._Key_comment: Set the Supabase API key via env var SUPABASE__KEY (not in this file). This file is tracked in git; secrets must never live here. The previous inline anon JWT (committed up to security/strip-supabase-jwt) was rotated and the old key was neutralized via Supabase RLS. Use service_role key in env var so backend can bypass RLS.
Supabase._ReadOnly_comment: true (env Supabase__ReadOnly=true) blocks every write to Supabase at the HTTP layer; reads and the read-only RPCs pass. For running the API against a live feed without persisting anything.

DataSync._comment: Incremental deal persistence: only deals added/changed since their last successful write, in paced chunks; persisted deals older than RetentionHours leave memory (Supabase keeps them); HardCap drops the oldest even if unsynced. Sized for the Live Bridge feed (26,000+ accounts, ~20,000 deals/hour).

Postgres._comment: v2 local PostgreSQL store. Password is NEVER stored here. Provide it either via env var Postgres__Password / a full Postgres__ConnectionString, or via PasswordFile (a path to a file containing only the password, kept outside the repo). ConnectionString (if set) wins over the discrete fields.

Centroid._Enabled_comment: false (env Centroid__Enabled=false) keeps the Centroid Bridge feed dormant whatever bridge_settings says; a second instance must not open its own Centroid session.
